name: ferrata_names
docs: Human-readable names for LEZ accounts, for the LEZ v0.4 test network (EXPERIMENTAL, UNAUDITED); program v2. Hand-written IDL in SPEL's format, as ferrata_bridge.idl.json.

Each instruction is a variant of the borsh enum named by instruction_type; discriminator is its one-byte variant index, followed by args in order. Instructions 0-8 are signed by an account (root at user(signer)); 9-15 are the program's own messages between its actors.
skeleton(n): replace every '0' by 'o' and every '1' by 'l', then every 'rn' by 'm', then every 'vv' by 'w' (left to right, no overlaps). Names with one skeleton share name(n): one of them at a time.

Names: 3-32 bytes of a-z, 0-9 and -, no leading or trailing -, no --; not reserved: no '-'-separated part whose skeleton, as it is or without its leading and trailing digits, is a reserved name's skeleton. At most 5 per account; 180-day term, 30-day grace; no fee on the test network.

Registration is commit and reveal: commit (numbered by sequence) stores sha256("ferrata-names/v2/commit/" || signer || salt || name); register reveals it from 4 minutes after the commit's now_ms, its whole window within the hour after it. The oldest commitment wins: a reveal of an older commitment takes a registration made in the hour before (Displaced).
Time: now_ms in a message sets the transaction's timestamp validity window to [now_ms, now_ms + 600000) ([now_ms, now_ms + 120000) for commit and register); a deadline must hold for the whole window.
Refusals exit with one byte, 230-236 and 240-254 (below); the bridge program also uses 240-255, so a code is read with the program that returned it.

instructions.name: register

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); PDA evidence while it holds no record

The reveal, signed. The signer's pending commitment must equal sha256("ferrata-names/v2/commit/" || signer || salt || name), now_ms >= its not_before_ms and now_ms + 120,000 <= its expires_ms; the commitment is spent and `user` sends Claim to name(n). Valid only in blocks within 120 s of now_ms. Emits Registered, or Displaced when it takes the name from a younger commitment.

instructions.name: renew

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); holds the record
Owner: extend to now_ms + 180 days; refused (LAPSED) unless now_ms + 600,000 <= expires_ms + 30 days. A renewal that may land after expiry drops the offer. Emits Renewed.

instructions.name: transfer

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); holds the record
Owner, now_ms + 600,000 <= expires_ms: offer the name to `to`, who takes it with accept; `to` = the owner withdraws the offer. Emits Offered.

instructions.name: set_target

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); holds the record
Owner, now_ms + 600,000 <= expires_ms: change what the name resolves to. Emits Updated.

instructions.name: release

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); holds the record; emptied
Owner, any time: free the name; it leaves the owner's list. Emits Released.

instructions.name: set_primary

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); holds the record (absent when clearing)
Set the signer's primary name (reverse record): the name must point at the signer, now_ms + 600,000 <= expires_ms. None clears it.

instructions.name: accept

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); holds the record

Take a name offered to the signer, now_ms + 600,000 <= expires_ms: it then points at the signer, with no private receiver; it joins the signer's list (at most 5). The previous owner's actor is not needed: the name stays in its list until it forgets it. Emits Transferred.

instructions.name: commit

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: sequence
docs: sequence: the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/sequence"); PDA evidence while it holds no state

Step 1 of registering: store the commitment at user(signer), replacing a pending one, numbered by `sequence` (Tick, Sequenced); revealable from now_ms + 240,000 ms (COMMIT_SLACK 120 s + MIN_REVEAL_DELAY 120 s) with the reveal's window ending by now_ms + 3,600,000 ms. Valid only in blocks within 120 s of now_ms.

instructions.name: forget

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: names
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); one per name (Disown); PDA evidence for one that holds nothing
Drop 1 to 5 distinct names from the signer's list that are no longer the signer's (accepted by another, registered afresh after they lapsed, or taken by an older commitment).

instructions.name: credit

accounts.name: user
docs: user(a), from name(name) only
Internal (from name(name) only): a now holds the name (added to its list once).

instructions.name: debit

accounts.name: user
docs: user(a), from name(name) only
Internal (from name(name) only): the name leaves a's list; clears it as primary.

instructions.name: primary

accounts.name: user
docs: user(a), from name(name) only
Internal (from name(name) only): make the name a's primary name.

instructions.name: claim

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); from user(a) only

Internal (from user(a) only, after it checked the reveal): register the name for a if the address is free, lapsed, or held by a registration with a larger commit_seq whose final_at (registered_ms + 3,600,000) is at least now_ms + 120,000; else TAKEN (or CONFUSABLE for a look-alike).

instructions.name: disown

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/name/" || skeleton(n)); from user(a) only
Internal (from user(a) only): refused while a owns the name (STILL_HELD), else Debit back to a.

instructions.name: tick

accounts.name: sequence
docs: sequence: the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v2/sequence"); PDA evidence while it holds no state
Internal (from user(a) only): add 1 to the counter and send Sequenced back.

instructions.name: sequenced

accounts.name: user
docs: user(a), from sequence only
Internal (from sequence only): number a's pending commitment.

types.name: PrivateReceiver
docs: What a sender needs to pay the name's holder privately: LEZ's nullifier public key and ML-KEM-768 viewing public key (1,184 bytes), as LEZ's wallet takes them (--to-npk, --to-vpk).

types.name: NameRecord
docs: The state of name(n); empty when free. The name it holds may be a look-alike of n (same skeleton): n resolves only if name == n and block time < expires_ms. Provisional until registered_ms + 3,600,000 (a reveal of a commitment with a smaller number can take it).

types.name: PendingCommit
docs: A commitment waiting for its reveal: seq numbers it among all commitments; the reveal needs now_ms >= not_before_ms and now_ms + 120,000 <= expires_ms.

types.name: UserState
docs: The state of user(a): the names in a's list (at most 5; those that left a without a signing stay until a forgets them), the primary name (counts only while that name is live and points at a), the pending commitment.

types.name: NameEvent
docs: ProgramEvent data of every change; selector = sha256("ferrata_names::<kind>")[..8], kind one of Registered, Displaced, Renewed, Offered, Transferred, Updated, Released.

errors.name: NO_COMMIT
errors.msg: `Register` by an account with no pending commitment (a reveal copied by another account that has none).

errors.name: COMMIT_MISMATCH
errors.msg: `Register` that does not match the signer's commitment: another name or salt, or a reveal copied by another account (the commitment binds the owner).

errors.name: TOO_EARLY
errors.msg: `Register` before the commitment's reveal window opens.

errors.name: COMMIT_EXPIRED
errors.msg: `Register` whose validity window reaches past the commitment's (the commitment is void).

errors.name: CONFUSABLE
errors.msg: `Register` of a name whose look-alike (same skeleton) is registered.

errors.name: STILL_HELD
errors.msg: `Forget` of a name the signer still owns (release it instead).

errors.name: NOT_HELD
errors.msg: `Forget` of a name not in the signer's list.

errors.name: BAD_MESSAGE
errors.msg: The message does not decode, a time out of range, a private receiver's keys of the wrong size, or a `Forget` of no names, of more than `MAX_NAMES` or of one twice.

errors.name: BAD_STATE
errors.msg: Stored state that does not decode (defensive: no transaction of this program writes such a state).

errors.name: NOT_SIGNED
errors.msg: A root message to `user(a)` that `a` did not sign.

errors.name: WRONG_SENDER
errors.msg: A message from another program, the program's own message signed by an account, or bookkeeping from an actor other than the one that sends it.

errors.name: WRONG_RECEIVER
errors.msg: A program message at an actor other than the one it is for (defensive: the program never sends one).

errors.name: INVALID_NAME
errors.msg: A name that breaks the rules (length, characters, hyphens).

errors.name: RESERVED_NAME
errors.msg: A reserved name or a variant of one.

errors.name: TAKEN
errors.msg: `Register` of a name that is held (live, or expired but within the grace period) and not displaceable.

errors.name: NOT_OWNER
errors.msg: An action on a name by an account that does not own it.

errors.name: EXPIRED
errors.msg: `Transfer`, `Accept`, `SetTarget` or `SetPrimary` that may land after the name's expiry.

errors.name: LAPSED
errors.msg: `Renew` that may land after the grace period.

errors.name: TOO_MANY
errors.msg: The account would hold more than `MAX_NAMES` names.

errors.name: NOT_FOUND
errors.msg: An action on a name that is not registered.

errors.name: SAME_OWNER
errors.msg: `Transfer` to the owner with no offer pending to withdraw.

errors.name: NOT_TARGET
errors.msg: `SetPrimary` of a name that does not point at the signer, or `Accept` of a name not offered to it.
